literal: in one birth tortoise like five controlling if capable in seven births too protection it has
translation: If a person can draw in their five senses like a tortoise in one lifetime, that self-control will protect them through seven lifetimes.
modern: ஒரு பிறப்பில் ஆமை தன் ஐந்து உறுப்புகளையும் ஓட்டுக்குள் அடக்கிக்கொள்வது போல, ஒருவன் தன் ஐம்புலன்களையும் அடக்கியாள வல்லவனானால், அந்த அடக்கம் அவனுக்கு ஏழு பிறப்பிலும் பாதுகாப்பைத் தரும்.
explanation: The couplet compares a person controlling their senses to a tortoise drawing its four limbs and head into its shell. Here, the word 'ஐந்து' (five) specifically refers to the five senses, which must be withdrawn from external temptations. If one can master this self-control in a single lifetime, that discipline becomes an enduring armor. The text contrasts one birth with seven births to show that the spiritual protection ('ஏமாப்பு') gained from self-control extends far beyond the present life.
